contract.boundary: Stay within the skill's declared scope, trust tier, and side-effect policy. Do not broaden scope without explicit user direction.
contract.rejection-policy: Validate every artifact against its declared JSON schema before emission. An invalid artifact is rejected and never passed downstream; record the rejection as a structured reason: {artifactType, schemaErrors[], attempt}. Retry a rejected artifact at most 3 attempts. The retry prompt keeps only the first format-error message and omits all prior format errors (SWE-agent ACI retry guardrail). Never drop a result silently: narrate an empty result explicitly ("ran successfully, no output") instead of emitting nothing.
